info.title: Money Money API
info.description: Personal finance API. Money values are integer centavos (PHP); dates are YYYY-MM-DD in the user timezone. All /api/v1 routes require a Clerk session token (Authorization: Bearer).

delete.summary: Delete an unused account (archive accounts that have transactions)

get.summary: Search and filter transactions (keyset paginated, newest first)

post.summary: Create a transaction (idempotent on the client-generated id)
post.description: Returns 201 when created and 200 when a transaction with the same id already exists. Set scheduledEventId (+ occurrenceDate) to convert a planned item into an actual transaction.

get.summary: Export transactions as CSV (same filters as the list)

post.summary: Import transactions from CSV (dry run by default; duplicates skipped on re-import)
Plan a future expense, bill, salary or contract income
post.description: Planned items change projections only; they never alter actual balances.

get.summary: Dated occurrences in a range (calendar/timeline), including paid and skipped

post.summary: Move an occurrence to a later (or earlier) date
Split part of a one-off item onto another date
Convert an occurrence into an actual transaction (no double counting)

get.summary: Monthly budgets with utilisation and spending pace
Savings goals with progress and projected completion

post.summary: Allocate (or withdraw, with a negative amount) money towards a goal
post.description: Allocations earmark money you already own; they are not expenses and do not change balances.

get.summary: Actual balance history plus a daily projection
get.description: History is computed from recorded transactions only. The projection starts from the actual balance today and adds scheduled inflows/outflows and remaining budgets for the chosen mode.

post.summary: Compare what-if scenarios against the baseline
Can I afford this? Simulate a purchase without saving anything

get.summary: Overview: actual position, this month, safe-to-spend, upcoming items and health

post.summary: Apply queued offline operations (idempotent per opId)
post.description: Operations are applied in order. Replaying an opId returns status "duplicate" without re-applying. Updates carrying a stale baseUpdatedAt return "conflict" with the server copy (server wins). Validation failures return "rejected" so clients stop retrying them.

get.summary: Changes since a server timestamp (full snapshot when omitted)
Latest database backup and restore-verification timestamps
